statement.p: Compute the length of the curve {\bf r\it(t)} = 6 t {\bf \, i} + 3 t {\bf \, j} +(t^2 - 4){\bf \, k} over the interval 0 \le t \le 3.
HINT: use the formula \int \sqrt{ t^2 + a^2} \, dt = \frac{1}{2} t \sqrt{t^2+a^2} + \frac{1}{2} a^2 \ln \left( t + \sqrt{t^2+a^2} \right) + C

static.solution:
\bf r\it(t) is \bf r\it'(t)=6 {\bf \, i}+3{\bf \, j}+2t{\bf \, k}.Using the Arc Length Formula we get: L = \int_0^{3} \left||\bf r\it'(t)\right||\,dt =\int_0^{3} \sqrt{{6}^2+{3}^2+(2t)^2}\,dt =\int_0^{3}\sqrt{4t^2+45}\,dt We substitute u=2t, \,du=2\,dt and use the given integration formula. This gives: L=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{6}\sqrt{u^2+45}\,du= \left.\frac{1}{4}u\sqrt{u^2+45}+\frac{1}{4}\cdot 45\ln\left(u+\sqrt{u^2+45}\right)\right|_0^{6}=
\frac{1}{4}6\sqrt{{6}^2+45}+\frac{45}{4}\ln\left(6+\sqrt{{6}^2+45}\right) - \frac{45}{4}\ln\sqrt{45}
=\frac{3}{2}\sqrt{81}+\frac{45}{4}\ln\left(6+\sqrt{81}\right) - \frac{45}{4}\ln\sqrt{45}=
\frac{3}{2}\sqrt{81}+\frac{45}{4}\ln\frac{6+\sqrt{81}}{\sqrt{45}} \approx 22.55
